preprocessing: patientwise z using unlabeled full same-patient context; mean imputer and StandardScaler fitted exclusively on outer FIT
training_seed: 42+1009*fold; same initial state and training reseed in A0/B1/B2
objective: one optimizer update per patient; mean(weight*unreduced BCE); pos_weight=binary FIT EZcount/NEZcount
PCA_solver: full deterministic float64 SVD, FIT-only and label-blind
projection_normalization: FIT-only population mean/std; zero or <=1e-12 std uses1
distance: mean squared distance in normalized PCA8; own channel excluded from both prototypes
tau: median strictly positive FIT conflict among eligible channels; no positive conflict means all raw weights1
weight_normalization: divide raw weight by same-patient observed-class mean; no clipping
B1_permutation: stable sorted channel IDs within each patient/class; seed from SHA256(JSON[42,fold,patient,label]); conditional identity-permutation rejection for nonconstant groups only, fixed before outcomes
stability_operator: for each queried channel exclude self; independently bootstrap remaining same and opposite class with replacement at original respective sizes; fixed FIT tau; re-normalize same-patient/class weights
stability_ranking: Spearman original vs resampled normalized weights within patient; identical constant vectors=1, one constant vector=0

feasibility_gate.stability_interpretation: conservative operational definition of extremely unstable; not clinical validity

bootstrap_unit: patient ID; all repeated validation appearances retained together; mean over cells

development_gate.worst_center_definition: minimum center Macro-F1 B2 minus minimum center Macro-F1 A0; additionally report change at A0 worst center
development_gate.worst_center_interpretation: conservative nondecline, not retrospective materiality tolerance

diagnostics: all selected thresholds and A0 frozen numeric threshold; A0 patient-F1 bins [0,.5,.65,1]; patient-equal score shifts and ranking; descriptive only
outer_test: no new outer evaluation authorized, even if development gates pass; historical B0 replay only exception
